properties.description: Persistent URI identifying this threshold rule.
Fixed type token identifying this record as a monitoring threshold (maps to sosa:ObservableProperty).

URI of the observable environmental parameter, preferably a GEOSS Essential Climate Variable (ECV) URI or a QUDT QuantityKind URI (e.g. https://qudt.org/vocab/quantitykind/Temperature for temperature).
The kind of threshold constraint: minValue (lower bound only), maxValue (upper bound only), range (both bounds), rateOfChange (maximum acceptable rate of change per unit time).
Lower bound of the acceptable range (required when thresholdType is minValue or range).
Upper bound of the acceptable range (required when thresholdType is maxValue or range).
Maximum acceptable rate of change per unit time (required when thresholdType is rateOfChange).
QUDT unit URI for the threshold value(s), e.g. https://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DEG_C for degrees Celsius or https://qudt.org/vocab/unit/PERCENT for relative humidity.
Alert severity level triggered when the threshold is breached: advisory (informational), warning (attention required), alarm (action required), critical (emergency response required).
URI of the monitoring point (ogc.heritage.monitoring-point) or heritage zone (ogc.heritage.heritage-site) to which this threshold applies.
Optional date range during which this threshold is in force (e.g. seasonal).
Start date of the active period (ISO 8601).
End date of the active period (ISO 8601).
URI or label of the technical standard, conservation protocol or expert opinion from which the threshold value is derived (e.g. EN 15757 climate specification).
Free-text explanation of the basis for the threshold value.
Date on which this threshold is scheduled for review (ISO 8601).
